topic_title: Environmental Hazards — Low-Water, Fog, Ice & Wind
prompt: What headlight setting is mandatory and safest when driving through dense morning fog in Texas?

options.text: High-beam headlights to project maximum luminous power through water droplets
Parking lights only to prevent blinding other drivers approaching from front
Low-beam headlights; high beams reflect off water droplets causing whiteout glare
Turn off all vehicle lights completely and follow the white shoulder stripe
